summary_en: 2,500,000 shares (2.4% of S/O), ¥6.465B upper limit, ToSTNeT-3 execution 06-19-2026 at ¥2,586/share (prior close), settlement same-day. Shares acquired will be deducted from authorized 5M-share, ¥10B program (May 13 board resolution); remaining authority to be deployed via open-market purchases.
title_en: Notice regarding acquisition of treasury stock via off-hours auction trading (ToSTNeT-3)
translation_en_brief: On 18 June 2026, Tsubakimoto Chain announced execution of a block acquisition of 2.5 million treasury shares (2.4% of shares outstanding) on 19 June 2026 via ToSTNeT-3 off-hours auction at ¥2,586 per share (the prior close), with a ¥6.465 billion upper limit. This block purchase is part of a larger 5 million-share, ¥10 billion authorization approved by the board on 13 May 2026 (covering the period 1 June 2026 through 31 March 2027). Following completion of this ToSTNeT-3 trade, the company intends to deploy the remaining authority (2.5 million shares and ¥3.535 billion) through open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The block execution is scheduled to settle immediately after the 08:45 trading window closes, with results announced at that time.
